Publication requires a commit in main history and the selected release policy. Published releases remain immutable.

The image upload job loads the checked image archives without an image build.
Both publication jobs require release-checks, which rejects any prerequisite result other than success.
No release job waits for a security scan job.
GitHub secret scanning reports secrets in this repository as alerts on the Security tab, and no scan result prevents a release.

The package job runs independently, the image job requires it, and release-checks joins the fast, package, deployment, browser, and image jobs.
The current version is 0.2.1 and test_releases is true, permitting immutable commit-tagged test releases without version or migration-path gates.

Terminal setup records successful tests in the spine and preserves the connection if it cannot record the result.

Terminal setup offers providers first, assigns connection names automatically, and limits another-provider search to the OpenCode catalog.
